_AboutFileName: The file name is expected to be named in a bulletGW+nameId+macAddr format.
_lastEditTime: The unix timestamp (GMT time) of last edit time.

gwConfig.name: FAN zone 1
gwConfig._name: A readable name of the gateway
gwConfig._nameId: A 4-byte hash ID to avoid the same name. nameId is the index.
gwConfig._macAddr: BLE MAC address of the gateway (separated by dashes) (readonly)
gwConfig._gatewayMode: The working mode of the gateway. 0: Just forwarding beacons; 1: Regular mode.

BLEConfig._BLE1TxPower: 0 dBm/-4 dBm/-8 dBm. The tx power (dBm) of BLE1
BLEConfig._BLE2TxPower: 0 dBm/-4 dBm/-8 dBm. The tx power (dBm) of BLE2
BLEConfig._BLE1Antenna: 0: built-in antenna, 1: external antenna. The antenna of BLE1.
BLEConfig._BLE2Antenna: 0: built-in antenna, 1: external antenna. The antenna of BLE1.
BLEConfig._BLEDuplicatedDrop: The time duration (in ms) for duplicated content dropping

timeConfig._timeStamp: Whether timestamp required for the received beacon
timeConfig._timeSetting: 0: time of gateway needs to be configured via BLE; 1: time would be fetched from an NTP server.
timeConfig._timeNTPUrl: NTP URL for time synchronization (only valid when TimeSetting is 1)

MQTTConfig._MQTTSecurityType: 0: no security for debug; 1: username and password; 2: TLS; 3: username and password with TLS. Cert file needs to be sent in other files. User name and password need to be configured using Froto via BLE.

IPConfig._DHCPEnable: If using static IP address, DHCPEnable should be set to false.
IPConfig._staticIPAddr: The static IP address (separated by full stop). (if DHCP is disable)
IPConfig._netMask: The net mask (separated by full stop). (if DHCP is disable)
IPConfig._DNSServer: The DNS server. (would be override if given)

gwConfig._childrenNumber: The number of sensors managed by the gateway

children.name: FAN point #1
children._name: A readable name of the sensor
children._nameId: A 4-byte hash ID to avoid the same name. nameId is the index.
children._BLESensorName: BLE name of the sensor (not mandatory)
children._macAddr: BLE MAC address of the sensor (separated by dashes)
children._waveDataAcqPeriod: The period (in S) to upload waveform data
